product.name: Monoprice DisplayPort 1.2a to VGA Active Adapter Black
product.description: Connect your DisplayPort® equipped PC to a VGA monitor using this DisplayPort 1.2a to VGA Active Adapter from Monoprice™!This adapter is designed to allow you to connect a VGA monitor to a DisplayPort video output. It conforms to the DisplayPort 1.2a standard and supports resolutions up to 1920x1080p @60Hz. Being an active adapter, it is fully compatible with the AMD® Eyefinity and nVidia® Surround™ multidisplay modes.It features a true 6" cable length with polycarbonate connector heads. The VGA end has panel screw holes, so you can secure the cable to the connector. The DP connector head measures about 15 x 26 x 31 mm. The VGA connector head measures about 20 x 42 x 47 mm.Features: Conforms to DisplayPort® 1.2a standardSupports VGA resolutions up to 1920x1080p @60HzACTIVE adapter is compatible with nVidia® Surround™ and AMD® Eyefinity multidisplay modesSupport Files: Spec Sheet (Oct 31, 2024)Monoprice™ and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
